status: Document findings resolved in reviewed owner checkpoint; image owner fixes and combined app validation pending

findings.issue: Tile-based reservation does not bound pattern surfaces. Pinned resvg 0.47.0 path.rs render_pattern_pixmap allocates pattern.rect multiplied by the effective transform, independently of output tile dimensions.
findings.action: Refuse patterns until their transformed surfaces and nested rendering are admitted, or implement conservative accounting before renderer entry. Add a bounded rejection/budget regression. This is separate from the already-reported marker expansion finding.

resolution.source_review: Marker and pattern definitions are refused before Tree::from_xmltree, including unused and CSS-selected definitions. Regression cases cover ordinary/large pattern geometry and per-vertex/inherited/style markers. Quoted URL scanner alignment also tightened.
resolution.owner_tests: 73 passed, 0 failed, 2 ignored; one Windows-only native runtime test excluded on Linux. Linux and Windows-target PDF Clippy and Cargo license/source/bans passed.
resolution.runtime_limits: PDFium/qpdf runtime, exported output, app wiring and physical acceptance remain pending. No repeated build in integration lane.

findings.issue: FillOrder tag 266 is admitted without checking its value. Pinned tiff 0.11.3 declares FillOrder with TODO support and its decoder does not interpret it.
findings.action: Reject nondefault FillOrder before decoder entry; verify with an independent 1x1 reversed-bit-order fixture. Pixel decoding was not executed in this review.

findings.issue: Legacy explicit color declarations, including TransferFunction, WhitePoint, PrimaryChromaticities and GrayResponseCurve, pass admission while only ICC is retained. Unsupported declared color can become UntaggedColor.
findings.action: Preserve and interpret supported declarations or return Error::Color when they cannot be honored; add small fixtures for the admitted/refused cases.

findings.issue: finish checks current tile membership but ignores the request viewport generation. viewport(A), next(r), cancel_view(), viewport(A), finish(r) permits the cancelled result again, contrary to the shared ownership contract.
findings.action: Check generation at completion and preserve/requeue still-wanted tiles when retiring older requests, including tiles skipped by next while an older request remained active.

diagnostics.decision: Closed schema and frozen report are the admitted interface direction. Bounded close reports pending and must retain the actual writer/publication owner. Final Android scope cancellation and Desktop Main close predicates require integration-owned wiring.

precision.next: Propose a bounded precision leaf-module/test lane after current module tests; integration retains shared APIs, registration and all eight composed app targets.

limits: No product build, runtime reproducer, stress input, provider call or device action was run for these findings.
No fixes were made in worker-owned modules. Their owners must resolve the findings and run regressions before promotion.
Existing worker recovery bases were not advanced to the additional precision archive commit.
